description: Customer messages typed by the author for 30 cases of the earlier 200-case world, written with the case records in view; not independent of the study and not used as labels (paper Table VI).

messages.label: R01
messages.message: Hi, I signed up for the Kestrel Pro Max holiday trade-in deal, but my bill looks like $67 after the discount instead of what was promised. Can you check my plan?

messages.label: R02
messages.message: I bought the Nimbus 7 Pro Max with the spring online deal, but I see two different charges on my statement for June. Which one is right?

messages.label: R03
messages.message: I upgraded to the Velo 9 Pro Max under the autumn loyalty promo, but I don't think the discount applied properly to my bill.

messages.label: R04
messages.message: Hello, I signed up for the 4-line unlimited plan with Strata 9 Pro and the upgrade credit, but my bill has a credit dated before my start date.

messages.label: R05
messages.message: My support chat says my bill is $100, but I had a trade-in credit of $11 that should make it $89. Why did the agent quote 100?

messages.label: R06
messages.message: I added 2 lines on the Aurel 7 Pro with the summer promotion, but my account shows two versions of the offer with different eligibility.

messages.label: R07
messages.message: I ordered the Strata 5 Plus online for the spring credit. Why does my bill list the same $138 charge twice?

messages.label: R08
messages.message: I got the Strata 9 Pro on the Connect plan expecting the online loyalty deal, but I was told my plan doesn't qualify.

messages.label: R09
messages.message: I purchased the Velo X Plus on Premium 2.0 with the loyalty credit, but I haven't received the full promised savings.

messages.label: R10
messages.message: I got the Velo X Pro last week. An agent said my bill is $175, but shouldn't my $25 credit have posted by now?

messages.label: R11
messages.message: I'm on the 3-line Go plan with the Lumen 7 Plus. The rep said my total is $124, but my statement shows a $19 credit was already applied.

messages.label: R12
messages.message: I purchased the Lumen Air Pro Max with the summer upgrade deal, but I don't see my activation date registered on my profile.

messages.label: R13
messages.message: I work here and used my employee discount for the Corvo Edge Pro upgrade, but support says employee accounts are excluded from the promo credit.

messages.label: R14
messages.message: Can you confirm my monthly charge for 3 lines on the Everyday plan with the Aurel 7 Plus trade-in credit? Support quoted $145.

messages.label: R15
messages.message: I signed up for the Lumen 7 Pro Max upgrade deal online, but I see two different terms posted for this offer in June.

messages.label: R16
messages.message: The representative told me my bill is $179 for my Nimbus 7, but I was promised a $23 back-to-school credit. Has it gone through?

messages.label: R17
messages.message: I switched my 3 lines over with the Aurel X Pro switcher deal, but customer service said they couldn't locate any offer on file for me.

messages.label: R18
messages.message: Why is there a 13 EUR charge/credit on my bill when my account is in US Dollars? The agent said my bill is $108.

messages.label: R19
messages.message: I took the Orbis 7 holiday deal for 2 lines, but my billing statement has mixed currencies listed and support quoted $127.

messages.label: R20
messages.message: I bought the Lumen 7 Plus on Unlimited Plus with the summer upgrade deal. Support told me my total is $96, is that right?

messages.label: R21
messages.message: I'm an employee on the Value plan with the Kestrel Edge Pro. The chat agent said my bill is $93, but did my upgrade promo apply?

messages.label: R22
messages.message: I looked at my June bill for the Kestrel 7 Pro and the credit amount has no currency attached to it. What is my real balance?

messages.label: R23
messages.message: I have 5 lines on Unlimited 2.0 with the Velo 9 Pro Max. The agent quoted $160, but my charges show $130 minus $30 credit. Why the gap?

messages.label: R24
messages.message: I bought an Aurel 7 under the spring upgrade promotion, but the system doesn't show any active offer attached to my account.

messages.label: R25
messages.message: The support agent said my net bill is $196 for my Corvo Edge Plus, but my statement has a $162 charge and a $34 trade-in credit.

messages.label: R26
messages.message: I got the Aurel X Pro with the winter switcher credit on 4 lines. An agent confirmed my total is $131—can you verify this?

messages.label: R27
messages.message: I have 6 lines with the Velo 9 winter loyalty reward, but the plan pricing table only lists rates up to 5 lines. How much is my plan?

messages.label: R28
messages.message: I got the Aurel 7 Pro with the holiday deal, but my account activation timestamp is blank. Will this affect my credit?

messages.label: R29
messages.message: I activated the Nimbus Edge Plus on the Everyday plan, but I didn't receive the autumn switcher credit.

messages.label: R30
messages.message: I got the Aurel 7 on the Value plan, but my activation was scheduled for July 1. Does the June credit still apply to me?
